prompt: The function $f$ is linear, with $f(2) = 9$ and $f(6) = 1$. What is the value of $f(10)$?
hint: The outputs are decreasing, so the slope is negative.

hints.text: The outputs are decreasing, so the slope is negative.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Try smaller steps: if $f(1) = 6$ and $f(2) = 4$, the slope is $-2$, so $f(3) = 2$. Each step of $+1$ in $x$ subtracts the same amount — that is all a negative slope means.

learningObjective: Extend a decreasing linear function beyond the given values.
explanation: Each step of $+1$ in $x$ lowers the output by $2$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Spot the pattern
steps: $x = 2, 6, 10$ are equally spaced — each gap is $4$.
Equal steps in $x$ produce equal steps in $y$ for a linear function, and the first step was $9 \to 1$, a drop of $8$.
So the next step drops $8$ again: $1 - 8 = -7$. No slope formula needed.

alternativeExplanations.title: ⚠️ The trap here
steps: Stepping the wrong way gives 1 + 8 = 9, the mirror image of the right answer.
The outputs fell from 9 to 1, so at a larger x they must be smaller still. Predict the sign of the answer first; −7 is the only choice below 1.
